title: The responsible person
notes: Dewlane Woche 1 (Produktion 01.11.2026), Vorlage 1.0, Qualitätsmaßstab Testvideo Q1. Thema aus dem Kalender: Jedes Produkt auf dem EU-Markt braucht eine verantwortliche Person in der EU, die für die Einhaltung der Regeln haftet. Nur Aussagen aus den Kalenderquellen (geöffnet 01.11.2026). Englische Fassung sprachlich angepasst.

beats.spoken: Who actually answers for your cream if something isn't right?

In the EU, the answer is Article 4 of the cosmetics regulation. A product can only be placed on the market if a responsible person inside the EU has been named for it. That person makes sure the rules are followed.

rows.text: makes sure the rules are followed

beats.spoken: Who that is depends on where the product comes from. For products made in the EU, it's the manufacturer. For imports, it's the importer. Either can appoint another person in the EU by written mandate. The mandate has to be accepted in writing, too.

nodes.text: in writing, to another person in the EU

beats.spoken: In the US, the responsible person only arrived with the MoCRA law in 2022. There, it's the manufacturer, packer or distributor whose name appears on the label.

rows.text: a person based in the EU

beats.spoken: That's why every pack in the EU shows the name or company and the address of the responsible person. For imported products, the country of origin is added. The details can be abbreviated, as long as the person can still be identified.
For you, that means: look for the name and address on the pack. That's who stands behind the product, and who you can contact.
Read the address first, then apply. Beauty knowledge, clearly explained: follow Dewlane.
